title: Gigahertz-clocked Generation of Highly Indistinguishable Photons at C-band Wavelengths
summary: High-performance single-photon sources at telecom C-band wavelentghs are key building blocks for applications in long-distance quantum communication. Here, we report the generation of highly indistinguishable, single photons at a clock-rate of 2.5 GHz. This is achieved by coherently driving the biexciton transition ($T_1^\mathrm{XX}=64(1)\,$ps) of a semiconductor quantum dot embedded in a microcavity with strong asymmetric Purcell enhancement.
